queries:
WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name,
           COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
)
SELECT district_name,
       account_count,
       printf('%d/%d', account_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account)) AS fraction_of_all_accounts
FROM district_counts
ORDER BY account_count DESC, district_id ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT d.district_id,
       COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
       100.0 * COUNT(a.account_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS percentage_of_all_accounts
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY account_count DESC, d.district_id
LIMIT 10

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
)
SELECT
    district_id,
    account_count,
    printf('%d/%d', account_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account)) AS account_fraction
FROM district_counts
WHERE account_count >= (
    SELECT account_count
    FROM district_counts
    ORDER BY account_count DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
)
ORDER BY account_count DESC, district_id

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT district, account_count,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY account_count DESC) AS district_rank
    FROM district_counts
)
SELECT district,
       account_count,
       100.0 * account_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS percentage_of_all_accounts
FROM ranked
WHERE district_rank <= 10
ORDER BY account_count DESC, district

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT district_name, account_count,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY account_count DESC) AS count_tier
    FROM district_counts
)
SELECT district_name,
       account_count,
       CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS account_fraction
FROM ranked
WHERE count_tier <= 10
ORDER BY account_count DESC, district_name

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT district, account_count,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY account_count DESC) AS count_tier
    FROM district_counts
)
SELECT district, account_count,
       100.0 * account_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS account_percentage
FROM ranked
WHERE count_tier <= 10
ORDER BY account_count DESC, district
